text:
maya: heads-up — seeing a weird gap in telemetry after routing tenant `acme-inc` from v1 -> v2 with soft-fallback enabled. console shows ~0 tokens on v2 but traces confirm requests actually hit v2 :thinking_face:

sam: I noticed a few similar spikes this morning. looks like per-route token counters weren't incrementing when the header got remapped during fallback.

jordan: is this the header-strip scenario? some proxies drop `X-Client-Version` so runtime falls back and the console routing layer loses the original route context.

chris: surfacing logs from the routing proxy: 
```
2026-03-21T09:12:03Z route_decision: tenant=acme-inc route=v2 fallback=true orig_header=X-Client-Version:null
2026-03-21T09:12:03Z telemetry_emit: route_tag=unknown tokens=0
```
looks like we emit telemetry with tag `unknown` which isn't aggregated into the v2 bucket.

maya: that would cause billing/usage mismatch. tenants will see quota drained on v1 but no v2 usage — bad for billing accuracy and alerts.

sam: short-term fix idea: when fallback happens, force-emit a synthetic `route_hint=v2` tag so console maps usage to v2. patch candidate in `eng-runtime` to add `route_hint` on decision.

jordan: careful — if requests back-and-forth (retry + fallback) we might double-count. we need idempotency key on route decisions (route_decision_id) and dedupe telemetry by that id.

chris: agree. alternative: always count tokens against the *primary* selected model in the decision graph and exclude telemetry on intermediate unknown tag. but that requires runtime to know final model before emitting.

maya: console UX ask: add a per-tenant banner/flag showing "compat-mode active" and a telemetry mismatch metric (v1_tokens - v2_tokens) with a drift alert >5% over 1h. product wants clear opt-in messaging.

sam: also we should add a debug toggle to emit full `route_decision_id` in the trace bundle for 24h when a tenant flags issues — helps support debug without full log retention.

console-bot: note recorded: created ticket PF-3241 for "compat telemetry gap — synthetic route tags + dedupe". assign to @sam and @jordan.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary patch (route_hint + decision_id) -> staging at 2026-03-21T13:00Z, canary prod 13:45Z if no regressions.

maya: plan sounds good. follow-ups: (1) sam/jordan implement route_decision_id + dedupe, (2) chris prototype primary-model-only counting, (3) product adds banner + alert, (4) run 24h canary and check drift metric.

sam: I'll open PR and link PF-3241. posting quick checklist in the ticket. :thumbsup:

jordan: I'll add a console visualization mock for the drift metric and the compat-mode banner.

maya: thanks everyone — if you spot other tenants with similar drift, ping here and drop tenant id.
